serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Yes, {f_playerName}?
Wait a moment. I gave her this name while she was unresponsive...
Was she listening to me back then? That's a bit... {{wi}}embarassing.
You: {f_botName} is the name I gave you before. Were you listening to me when I did it?
Bot: ...
Bot: Negative. Processing was offline most of the time and when it wasn't it was only barely functioning, so I only heard some things. 
Bot: And I have no memory of you giving me this name.
You: Why did you say your name is Jun?
Bot: I'm not sure...
Bot: Let me check if there's any information related to this in my database.
Bot: ...
Bot: I believe "Jun" is my model name.
Huh? Huh? How did I come up with this name before then? I am certain I didn't see the model name anywhere on her.
...
Weird...
Is this world even real?
...
I don't even know what to think anymore.
...
Is someone watching me? Are you there?
Who are you?
Why are you here?
...
Ehhhh, guess it doesn't matter. Hope you enjoy yourself.
